summary: Sprint G.7 supplement (G.7-bis) — Villa Riviera demo Journey seed VALIDATED end-to-end. Backend: 33/33 G.7+G.7-bis tests pass (5 new test_iteration_108_villa_riviera_seed.py + 18 G.7 companion + 10 G.7 RBAC). Full G.x regression: 124/124 pass (test_iteration_10*.py). Seed script idempotency confirmed by two consecutive runs — counts stable: 10 milestones, 3 moodboards, 3 milestone_versions, 8 milestone_feedback voices, 16 journey_timeline_events. GET /api/client/journeys returns zero_data=false with project_title='Villa Riviera', studio_name='MOOD Demo Studio', current_chapter.title='Moodboard Direction™'. GET /api/client/journeys/{jid}/companion returns header.location='Sanremo, Liguria', approved_chapters≥2, active_chapter.milestone_type='moodboard_direction', 3 shared_directions (titles contain 'fredda', 'materic', 'alternativ'/'living'), ≥6 conversations with 'più calore' + 'travertino' + 'pietra grigia' present, ≥10 evolution_timeline with 'brief'+'moodboard'+'material direction'+'revisione'+'travertino'+'scartata', ≥2 memory_archive chapters. Voci editoriali use Italian-only tone — 'Tu' (cliente) + 'Il tuo studio' (studio), no SaaS jargon. Frontend DESKTOP (1920x1080) walkthrough live: login as client@moodfordesign.com auto-redirects /client → /client/journey/a0745567-3cd1-499f-99fc-a04298af7e22 (single-journey shortcut). Hero renders full Mediterranean villa cover with pill 'IL VIAGGIO È IN CORSO', editorial subtitle 'Capitolo attivo · Moodboard Direction™. La direzione editoriale prende forma in una composizione narrativa.', meta strip 'SANREMO, LIGURIA · RESIDENZIALE · RESTYLE INTEGRALE · 2 DI 10 CAPITOLI APPROVATI', and CTA 'ESPLORA IL CAPITOLO'. Topbar 'Bentornato, Marco · Il tuo percorso progettuale ti aspetta'. Sidebar shows 7 Journey-first ™ sections + 'SCRIVI AL TUO STUDIO' CTA. Scroll reveals 'Direzioni condivise · Shared Directions™ · 3 direzioni' with 3 moodboard cards (fredda V1, materica V2, alternativa V3). All 15 editorial needles found in DOM (Villa Riviera, Sanremo, fredda, materic, alternativ, travertino, pietra grigia, più calore, MOOD Demo Studio, Brief, Inspirations, 2 di 10, Residenziale, IL VIAGGIO È IN CORSO, Moodboard Direction). Frontend MOBILE (390x844 — iPhone 13 Pro): sidebar collapsed, hamburger button present (data-testid found), tap opens drawer with all 7 Journey-first sections; hero full-width with cover, meta pills wrap vertically on 3 rows (SANREMO/LIGURIA · RESIDENZIALE / RESTYLE / 2 DI 10), 'ESPLORA IL CAPITOLO' CTA visible. The demo successfully avoids the 'too perfect / marketing showroom' pitfall — visible frictions (revision_requested status on V1, 'pietra grigia scartata' event, client requesting more warmth, palette evolution travertino vs Calacatta swap) make it read as an authentic in-progress project.

Editorial tone is consistent in milestone_feedback voices — Italian only, conversational, with realistic friction (kind='wants_more_material' + kind='palette_works' + kind='request_variant' map cleanly to FEEDBACK_LABEL in milestone_dialogue.py).

16 journey_timeline_events span 8 weeks with realistic offsets (day 0 → day 56) and include the critical narrative beats: milestone_started, milestone_approved, milestone_revision_requested, voice_received, material_rejected ('Pietra grigia originale — scartata'), material_selected (travertino).

3 moodboards correctly express the lifecycle progression: V1 status='revision_requested' (frizione), V2 status='viewed' (current direction), V3 status='draft' (alternativa in lavorazione). Each carries Unsplash cover + palette + rationale + ai_metadata for the Companion to render shared_directions cards.
ClientDashboardLayout.jsx mobile drawer (<md breakpoint) verified live at 390x844 — hamburger opens drawer with 7 sections, scroll locks correctly, route change closes drawer.
Single-journey auto-redirect in ClientJourneysIndexPage.jsx works end-to-end — /client → /client/journey/{id} fires correctly when journeys.length===1.
Test pinning ensures direction lock — test_voices_use_italian_only blocks future drift toward English SaaS copy ('approve this', 'click to', 'deadline', 'approval queue', 'task list').
Companion endpoint shape unchanged from iter107 — backwards compatible (lifecycle_label enum still valid, 7 sections still present).
